limits: Only existing recorded bytes are read. No compiler, browser, benchmark, model, or project checker is invoked.
Shared reviewed metadata routines decode actual archive, performance, and browser proofs; exact source, commands, attempts, and inheritance are separately checked below.
This audit grants no full-family closure, omission, release, native-conformance, Safari, manual assistive-technology, or token result. Historical failures keep their original scope.

parent.scope: Committed M3.3 and all protected ancestors retain their exact bytes, attempts, controls, and prior limitations; no historical runtime is rerun or recertified.

source_review.scope: Immutable pre-canonical source/focus observations keep their pending-at-capture fields. The final wrapper owns later acceptance.
